title: Deck Sage | Free AI-Powered MTG Deck & Collection Tools
description: Free Magic: The Gathering tools for cards, Commander decks and collections, with on-device card scanning and an optional AI gameplay coach.
headline: Free tools.
AI help.
More Magic.
intro: Build and organize Magic: The Gathering decks, explore cards and Commander precons, and get optional on-device AI help. Deck Sage is free to use.
aiExplanation: Scan card names on your device and try the optional AI Gameplay Coach on a compatible WebGPU browser. Card search, collection management and rules-based deck checks work alongside AI assistance; not every tool uses a language model.
privacy: Browse the public library without signing in. Sign in to manage your private decks and collection. Public guides never include your saved cards or account details.
shopping: Website tools are free to use. Physical cards cost money, and purchasing them is optional. Affiliate link — Deck Sage may earn a commission on qualifying purchases.

bulk.title: Discover Commander decks in the cards you already own.
bulk.description: Sign in and add cards to My Bulk, then find possible Commander deck cores using learned card relationships. Review owned-card coverage, legal command zones and missing cards before you choose a plan. Some proposals are incomplete; a filled list is not a promise of playability.
